Research in the GATOR Lab is supported by competitive grants and industry partnerships. For an overview of our broader research philosophy and computing infrastructure, see [Our Vision & Stack](stack.qmd).

## Projects & Research Support

### 2026

* **Geographic Expansion and Improvements of the Future Shorelines Tool** (2026–2028)  
  **Sponsor:** U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (sub-award from Florida International University)  
  **Support:** ~$259K

  Expands and enhances [Future Shorelines](https://futureshorelines.fiu.edu/), a geospatial decision-support tool designed to increase the climate resiliency of nature-based solutions in South Florida, by integrating new environmental layers (seagrass coverage and sediment type), extending geographic coverage across Martin and Palm Beach Counties, and implementing dynamic profiling.

* **Accelerate Scientific Workflows in Google Antigravity** (2026)  
  **Sponsor:** Google  
  **Support:** Access to Google Antigravity's highest tier

  Supports the lab's research on reliable agentic AI workflows, autonomous spatial intelligence, and scientific computing through a global Google initiative selecting 10,000 scientists worldwide.
